subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this UI resolver fix, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the active candidate fix is in a fork with stale checks and no maintainer-edit access, which automation should not supersede without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, resolve the stale check state, and handle the fork constraints.

options.title: Replace with a same-repository PR
options.body: Close or leave the fork PR as reference and ask for a fresh same-repository UI-only resolver fix with Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh proof, resolve the stale check state, and handle the fork constraints.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the channel UI/catalog refactor and current metadata-driven resolver path.
